content: my LED cable is definitely too short and I cannot pull it to move. I have to take the left panels back off to get access to the cable ties to loosen them. This would have been much easier if done earlier.

If you have a buddy cam (the next step) mount it before closing the lid.

Also, if you're using any tpu-printed grommets (https://www.printables.com/model/1803258-indx-top-cover-grommet-split) now is the time to install them in the back. It's easier to do with the lid up from the top.

None of this is a big deal because it's literally a matter of lifting the lid again...but putting it here anyway.
Same as others, cable of the LED Strip too short, need to work on that now... should really be mentioned.

If you follow the instructions, lighting is not good for the first several layers. I used this mount to put the LED stripe back to it‘s original position: https://www.printables.com/model/1833710-core-one-indx-fe-chamber-led-light-bar-fix
Lighting is now perfect!

Actually it turned out you can put the entire led panel in front of the nozzle seal holders, however you have to position it prior attaching the tool dock panel. No need for 3rd party prints. This way, you won't loose the light on the first layers.

replies.content:
Works!
The area where the LED strip fits is behind the "PRUSA x INDX". Just remove the strip from the old metal bar and attach it on the new toolholder/plate, LEDs facing to the print are ofc.

The new spot should be on the exact same height as the old one.

content: Also hat not enough cable left vor the LED-panel. Luckily i did not tighten the zipties that much. Hint needs to be added way earlier.
Confirm - too late for pulling cable easily. Mention it before when there is no sidepanel mounted yet.
It is way too late to check for slack in LED panel cable. It should be mentioned earlier, when the left panel was off. I had zipties so tight that it made pulling the cable impossible.
